decisions.statement: Every name an import line names is answered with the path it comes from.
A name is answered as a type where its line or its own entry says type.
A name spelled as a key rather than reached is not among the names a node names.
A name imported under another name is answered by the name at its source.
A name taken out of a line leaves the other names that line carries.
Names taken out of a body together leave one passage for each line those names sat on.
A line losing every name that line carried leaves no line.
A line naming everything a path exports is answered under the name it binds.
Such a line is written from that name and that path rather than from a list.
The only name such a line carries is that name, so taking it leaves no line.
The anchor a body offers is the last import line that body holds.
A body holding no import line offers no anchor.
A line put into a body follows the anchor that body offers.
A line opening a body with no anchor is parted from that body by a blank line.
A line spelling no path is refused rather than composed.
An import from an empty path is whole syntax, so no parse catches it.
Nothing here reads the disk or the index.
Nothing here decides which lines a body should carry.
A name put into a body joins the line that body already takes from that path.
A value joining a line marked type throughout marks every name that line already carried.
A type joining a line of values is marked a type on its own.
A body holding no line from that path, or a line already naming it, takes no name.
A line bound under a default name is joined by no name.
Names repointed to another path leave their line and join the line from that path.
A line every name repointed leaves goes whole rather than staying empty.
Names repointed where the body takes no line from that path are written as a line of their own.
A line every name repointed leaves is respelled where there is no line to join.
Every name a body's import lines bind is answered together with the name at its source.
Names taken from one path are written as one line, and a namespace name as a line of its own.

definition: the import lines a body carries, read and written as text
